patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, bold serif headline on the left and layered, interactive app screenshots on the right.
Prominent use of a large, impactful display serif font for main headings, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A distinctive olive green is used as a primary accent color for calls to action and specific section backgrounds, providing a fresh contrast to the dominant white and dark gray palette.
The main navigation bar transforms from a transparent state to a sticky bar with a solid white background and subtle shadow as the user scrolls past the hero section.

Content sections and individual elements within sections (like app screenshots and text blocks) reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Feature sections frequently integrate detailed app screenshots, often presented with a slight perspective or layered effect, to visually explain product capabilities.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, implement a scroll-triggered animation library (like locomotive-scroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger) to handle smooth scrolling and orchestrate element reveals. Sections should fade and slide into view as they enter the viewport. The navigation bar should use a sticky position with a CSS transition to change its background and add a shadow once a specific scroll threshold is met.

Create an asymmetrical hero layout using a grid or flexbox, dedicating more space to the headline and subtext on one side, and layering multiple image assets with subtle z-index variations and transforms on the other to create depth.

Utilize a strong typographic hierarchy with a custom display serif font for large, impactful headlines and a clean sans-serif for all other text, ensuring ample line height and letter spacing for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels and clear body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and UI elements within app screenshots, otherwise sharp edges for section containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of openness, with balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a bold, elegant display serif typeface for headlines, paired with a vibrant olive green accent, creates a sophisticated yet modern aesthetic. The integration of detailed, layered app screenshots as primary visual elements, often with a slight 3D perspective, effectively showcases the product's interface and features.
